test_set_value: test DataFrame._set_value method to set a value at a specific row index and column label
test_set_value_resize: test DataFrame._set_value method to resize the DataFrame by adding a new row and column with various data types
test_set_value_with_index_dtype_change: test DataFrame._set_value method when setting values with integer and string index/column combinations that may create new rows or columns
test_set_value_type_coercion: test DataFrame._set_value type coercion behavior for string, boolean, and numeric values assigned to new columns
test_set_value_invalid_value: test DataFrame._set_value raises TypeError when assigning an invalid value to a float column
